LanguageData.ARIO_TrialRules: Choose two adult champions and propose the trial. A random site appears near your keep. Bring your champion and another free adult colonist by caravan, then confirm Autoresolve trial. There is no arena or live fight. Melee skill, equipment, armour and health determine the odds when the trial is agreed; reloading does not change the result. Both champions can be wounded and the loser risks death. Victory: +4 Integrity, +8 goodwill. Defeat: −4 Integrity.
LanguageData.ARIO_TrialSigningConfirm: Reserve these champions? You have ten days to travel to a random nearby site and confirm autoresolve. Bring another free adult colonist to bring home your champion if wounded or killed. Odds and consequences are fixed when this agreement is signed; changing gear or reloading afterward does not reroll them. One active trial, 30-day House cooldown. Other accepted diplomatic terms execute at signing, independently of the trial.
LanguageData.ARIO_TrialSigned: {0} accepted trial by combat. A random site is marked near your keep. Bring your champion and another free adult colonist there by caravan within ten days, then confirm Autoresolve trial. No combat map is needed.\n\n{1}
LanguageData.ARIO_TrialReady: The trial ground is ready. Move your champion to within 20 cells of the sand court's centre. Keep spectators back. Select the world site or use the active agreement in House → Diplomacy → Begin trial. Confirming starts real, potentially lethal melee combat. Begin within one day or the original earlier deadline.\n\n{1}
LanguageData.ARIO_TrialBeginConfirm: {0}\n\nBegin the real duel now? Downing or death decides it. A lethal hit can kill your champion; surviving losers can bleed out unless treated. Wounds, lost limbs and death are permanent; equipment is at risk. The mod issues melee orders to these two people only. Do not issue different orders or attack with spectators unless you intend to forfeit. No one is invulnerable. Bring your champion near the sand court and keep the escort back.
LanguageData.ARIO_TrialRescue: Return to trial ground for rescue
LanguageData.ARIO_TrialUnavailable: The trial cannot proceed. Both named champions must remain free, fit adults and the Houses at peace. Your caravan must bring the exact champion plus another free permanent adult colonist to the marked site before the deadline. Captives, quests and other reservations cannot be overridden.
LanguageData.ARIO_TrialWithdrawConfirm: Cancel this trial for 8 Integrity? Neither champion is harmed by cancellation. Other accepted diplomatic terms are not undone.
LanguageData.ARIO_TrialEvacuateDesc: Reform your caravan after the trial. Bring your wounded, the fallen and their belongings with you. An incapacitated foreign champion remains on the battlefield until rescued.
LanguageData.ARIO_TrialEvacuateBlocked: End or surrender the trial first. Other active threats and buildings that block map removal must also be resolved.
LanguageData.ARIO_TrialDeadline: Time to reach the trial site: {0}
LanguageData.ARIO_TrialDebugCreated: A NEW 25-year-old champion of {0} is now a retained world pawn for trial testing. Existing people, goodwill and acceptance rolls were not changed. Choose an adult player champion in Diplomacy → Trial by combat. If either champion is incapable of violence, select another; normal eligibility and acceptance still apply.
LanguageData.ARIO_TrialDebugUnavailable: A player-home map and a peaceful Westerosi House available for a trial are required.
LanguageData.ARIO_TrialRandomSite: A random trial site will be marked near your keep.
LanguageData.ARIO_TrialAutoConfirm:
{0} faces {1}. Your agreed victory chance is {2}.

Resolve the trial now? Both champions can be wounded, and the loser faces a 15% chance of death. Existing injuries or later bleeding can also prove fatal. The outcome was fixed when the trial was signed; reloading will not change it.

Survivors keep their allegiance and belongings. Your champion returns to the caravan, while your escort brings home anyone who falls.
LanguageData.ARIO_TrialLegacyEnded: The old live-arena trial with {0} has been retired without a new judgement. Existing injuries and people remain. If its old map is occupied, use the rescue/evacuation options; no new fight starts.\n\n{1}
